calls.title: KBYG - SV Dinner
calls.summary: The team laid out detailed plans for a dinner event scheduled at the Village Pub, emphasizing attendee experience from setup to engagement. The event is set for tomorrow from 6:30 to 9:30 PM, with cocktails and networking starting promptly at 6:30. They arranged seating for up to eight guests at six round tables, confirmed dietary accommodations, and refined swag items, managing name tags proactively. The informal atmosphere aims to foster natural conversations about industry trends, with specific conversation topics prepared to enhance engagement. Attendance tracking is enhanced with requests for unclaimed name tags, ensuring a balanced guest mix. The menu prioritizes dietary needs, featuring curated wines and a casual dining experience during the cocktail hour.
calls.keywords: swag contract, dinner event, seating arrangements, attendee tracking, networking, attendee dossiers
